segments.text: If they that are Christs have crucified the flesh, &c. Then as ever we hope to make good our claim to Christ, let us give all diligence to mortifie sin, in vain else are all our pretences unto Union with him. This is the great work, and discriminating character of a believer. And seeing it is the main business of life, and great evidence for heaven, I shall therefore press you to it by the following Motives and Considerations.
